content: Kleppmann on distributed locks: locks are leases that can expire mid-execution (GC pause, disk stall, network delay); process cannot reliably detect expiry; fencing tokens are the correctness fix and Redlock lacks them; for efficiency purposes single Redis SET NX PX with compare-and-delete release is acceptable and occasional failure is fine; for correctness rely on transactional storage (Postgres) guards instead of the lock.
